Site Report: nzd0001

Location: Northland, New Zealand / Aotearoa

Site Statistics

This table summarizes the key statistics for the site.

id area beach_length easting northing median_slope
nzd0001 3.069 km² 3.28 km -4085.6 km -4085.6 km 0.0817

This dataset contains 33 transects associated with the shoreline at site nzd0001 . Each transect represents a segment of the coastline for which elevation and positional data have been analysed to estimate shoreline change trends and related metrics. The orientation of transects spans from 313.059 ° to 359.037 °, with a mean orientation of 333.134 °, indicating the general alignment of shoreline segments within this site.

In terms of shoreline change:

  • The average linear trend across all transects is -0.009 m/year, with individual values ranging from -0.403 to 0.541 , suggesting a net erosional trend overall.

  • The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of the trend model averages 15.21 m, indicating the typical deviation between observed points and the fitted trend line.

Confidence intervals on shoreline position trends are also available:

  • The mean lower bound is 0.068 , and the mean upper bound is 0.11 , reflecting the uncertainty range around trend estimates.

The number of valid data points per transect ( n_points_nonan ) ranges from 150 to 185 , with an average of 176.636 .

Site Zone Analysis

Site Zone Configuration

No areas of interest (AOIs) were identified for this site. This may be due to the min_zone_length ( ) parameter being set too high, or the transect data not meeting the criteria for any defined zones.

This site has been divided in to 4 zones consisting of at minimum 3 transects each. To increase or decrease the sensitivity of the zone definitions (i.e. the number of transects required to define a zone), you can adjust the min_zone_length parameter in the run_narrative_zoning function call above. Zone definitions are customisable, and extensible, and can be modified and extended by editing the aoi_definitions dictionary in the run_narrative_zoning function call above. Zone definitions applied to this site can be found in section Area of Interest Definitions at the bottom of this report.

Narrative Generation Configuration

Area of Interest Definitions

The area of interest (AOI) definitions are used to categorise shoreline segments based on their trends and characteristics. Each AOI has a priority, conditions for classification, and a description template for narrative generation. This report returns zones with, at minimum, 3 transects.

AOI Name Priority Conditions
No Data 1 If the `trend` of the intersect is null.
Rapid Erosion 2 If the `trend` of the intersect is less than -0.8.
Moderate Erosion 3 If the `trend` of the intersect is less than -0.3.
Rapid Accretion 4 If the `trend` of the intersect is greater than 0.8.
Moderate Accretion 5 If the `trend` of the intersect is greater than 0.3.
High Uncertainty 6 If the `r2_score` of the intersect is less than 0.05. If the `rmse` of the intersect is greater than 30.
Steep Beach 7 If the `beach_slope` of the intersect is greater than 0.08.
Low Energy 8 If the `beach_slope` of the intersect is less than 0.04.
Stable 9 –
